title: fix(money): real package statistics and paused subscription pricing (T4)
body:
## MONEY-CONNECT-124 — agent 124 (T4)

### Normal-use blockers fixed
- **B-PACKAGE-1:** A coach opens a sold $49/month package and reads zero clients and zero MRR because the management route returned only the raw package row. Management reads now return distinct clients with access and currency-scoped paid MRR using the same monthly math as Money, purchase price snapshots, and one rounding per package. Free access, trials and one-time sales are not recurring revenue.
- **B-PACKAGE-2 (backend half):** A coach opens subscribers but the mobile view cannot name its clients because the allow-listed purchase rows omit the client name. Subscriber pages now add an explicitly selected name/email, real package currency and full-package statistics. Stripe secrets and internal provider fields remain absent.
- **B-PRICING-1:** A coach changes a package's price or cadence while the client's app access is paused, then restarts the still-live Stripe subscription; Stripe keeps the old price while TGP's package-derived billing display/MRR uses the new cadence. Live Stripe subscriptions now keep the existing pricing lock even with paused app access. Canceled subscriptions still release it. Reads expose the exact lock state instead of guessing from client count.

### Proof
- Regression: `test/money-connect-package-views.spec.ts`; existing pricing-lock regression updated only for inactive app access with a live subscription.
- Main-red CI lane: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37518791455 (package view regressions on unchanged main).
- A targeted hermetic check of actual transpiled backend/mobile modules failed on main and passed on this implementation for catalog statistics, allow-listed client identity, paused-subscription pricing, quarterly roundtrips and subscriber currency/amount mapping. This supplements, not replaces, PR CI.
- Existing coach privacy fixture now supplies the real package currency/cadence; its planted-secret assertions are unchanged.

### Boundaries and coordination
- No schema, migration, lockfile, fee-policy, checkout, transfer, Stripe API or production changes.
- Existing separate-charge/transfer and `on_behalf_of` math retained; no second application-fee debit.
- Shared-file coordination recorded with MONEY-REFUND-124: no archive/create/refund behavior changed. Only read methods and one pricing-lock predicate plus its existing test change.
- Mobile companion PR adapts the actual subscriber contract and stops inventing missing statistics.
- No merge, deploy, CI cancellation, production write, secrets or spend.

Recommended default: preserve existing subscribers' terms, including paused plans; create a new package for new pricing.
